headline: Policy Subcommittee to review and approve recommendations for Section I and Section J policies.
summary: The subcommittee will review proposed changes to Section I and Section J policies, including analysis documents for each section. Public participation is also on the agenda.
items: Review and Approval of Recommendations for Section I (Section I Analysis, Section I with changes)
Review and Approval of Recommendations for Section J (Section J Analysis, Section J with changes)
